name: atlassian
description: Jira and Confluence MCP tools: issues, sprints, boards, worklogs, pages, spaces, search, attachments.

jira_url.title: Jira URL
jira_url.description: Base URL of your Jira site, e.g. https://jira.example.com. Required for any Jira tool; pair it with jira_personal_token (Server / Data Center) or jira_username + jira_api_token (Cloud). Leave empty to disable Jira tools.

jira_username.title: Jira username / email
jira_username.description: Cloud basic auth only: email of your Atlassian account, paired with jira_api_token. Leave empty when using jira_personal_token.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: Cloud basic auth only: Atlassian Cloud API token from id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens, paired with jira_username. Leave empty when using jira_personal_token.

jira_personal_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_personal_token.description: Personal access token (PAT) for Jira, the primary auth for Server / Data Center: create it under Profile > Personal Access Tokens. Atlassian Cloud has no PAT, so use jira_username + jira_api_token there. With a PAT, two Cloud-only tools (jira_batch_get_changelogs, jira_move_issue) are unavailable.

confluence_url.title: Confluence URL
confluence_url.description: Base URL of your Confluence site, e.g. https://confluence.example.com (Cloud: https://your-domain.atlassian.net/wiki). Required for any Confluence tool; pair it with confluence_personal_token (Server / Data Center) or confluence_username + confluence_api_token (Cloud). Leave empty to disable Confluence tools.

confluence_username.title: Confluence username / email
confluence_username.description: Cloud basic auth only: email of your Atlassian account, paired with confluence_api_token. Leave empty when using confluence_personal_token.

confluence_api_token.title: Confluence API token
confluence_api_token.description: Cloud basic auth only: Atlassian Cloud API token from id.atlassian.com > Security > API tokens, paired with confluence_username. Leave empty when using confluence_personal_token.

confluence_personal_token.title: Confluence personal access token
confluence_personal_token.description: Personal access token (PAT) for Confluence, the primary auth for Server / Data Center: create it under Profile > Personal Access Tokens. Atlassian Cloud has no PAT, so use confluence_username + confluence_api_token there.

read_only_mode.title: Read-only mode
read_only_mode.description: When on, hides and blocks every create/update/delete tool (issues, comments, pages, attachments).
